Name: Modular Fish Tanks
Author: mushymato
Description:
[size=6]Now you can 🐟 and 🐟🪸🐟 and 🐟🐠🐠🪸🐟🐟🦈.[/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/36938/36938-1756082026-697977583.gif[/img]

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] , [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url]
[*]Download and extract this mod.
[/list]

The fish tanks are available from the furniture catalogue, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] is highly recommended!

[size=5][b]How does it Work?[/b][/size]

The tanks in this mod are either 1 tile wide or 2 tile wide, but with the power of connected textures (MMAP feature) they become one when placed next to each other.
With happy home designer, you can deploy multiple tanks at once by holding down left-shift (the give modifier).
Internally, they are still separate containers, so if you get a message saying "You cannot add any more items of this type", try again on the next tank over.
You can tell how many fish/decorations are in each tank by moving them apart.

There are also some fish tanks + deco pieces that look like water, inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35787]WSilenceW's WaterRipples[/url]. These utilize the actual water texture straight from the game, so it will be affected by recolors. You can set additional draw color in the configs using a named color or hex.

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/tlitookilakin?gameId=1303]tlitookilakin[/url] did the original connected textures code which I adapted.
Assets in this mod are all vanilla edits by me.
